summary: A diary notes a small sum given toward a public celebration.
realLife: On 29 May 1660 Pepys gave Deal's people twenty shillings for their bonfire.
sources: Diary of Samuel Pepys, May 1660, Wikisource: https://en.wikisource.org/wiki/Diary_of_Samuel_Pepys/1660/May
inGame: needs: a record of a small gift to a public occasion; the money engine holds gifts to causes, not celebrations.
